$comment: The credential inventory ([OP-05], spec 01 §9.6): every staging credential's name, holder, issuer, dates, cadence and runbook. Never a value, an ID or an address. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, or null until the credential is issued. A row without a runbook names the lane or step that brings it.

credentials.name: cloudflare-operator-token
credentials.holder: the operator, as a file named by FIN_CF_TOKEN_FILE, per run
credentials.cadence: short expiry; replaced with spec 01 §7.10's narrow operator token

credentials.name: railway-project-token
credentials.holder: the operator (FIN_RAILWAY_TOKEN_FILE); later the staging environment's RAILWAY_TOKEN
credentials.cadence: 90 days, and at once after any Railway security notice

credentials.name: static-deploy-token
credentials.holder: the staging-static environment only (CF_STATIC_DEPLOY_TOKEN), once it exists; never the operator machine and never the secure prompt
credentials.issuer: cloudflare (minted when staging-static is created, after the owner is back)
credentials.cadence: 90 days, with the front door's secrets ([FD-12])

credentials.name: static-run-token
credentials.holder: one pnpm fin static deploy run on the operator machine, in memory only
credentials.issuer: cloudflare (minted by pnpm fin with CR-05: Workers Scripts Write on the staging account only)
credentials.cadence: one run: expires within 60 minutes, revoked when the run ends

credentials.name: tunnel-token-public
credentials.issuer: cloudflare (pnpm fin tunnel create staging public)
credentials.cadence: 90 days, and at once on any notice ([FD-12])

credentials.name: tunnel-token-admin
credentials.issuer: cloudflare (pnpm fin tunnel create staging admin)
credentials.cadence: 90 days, and at once on any notice ([FD-12])

credentials.name: ingress-proofs
credentials.holder: edge, console, admin and verify, sealed FIN_INGRESS_PROOFS; the zone's request-header transform rules

credentials.name: email-token
credentials.cadence: 180 days at most, IP-filtered to worker's static egress

credentials.name: betterstack-team-tokens
credentials.holder: the operator (FIN_BETTERSTACK_TELEMETRY_TOKEN_FILE, FIN_BETTERSTACK_UPTIME_TOKEN_FILE); the CI Telemetry token in the staging environment
credentials.pending: P0-F's monitoring apply pull request adds rotate-betterstack.md

credentials.name: service-telemetry-and-heartbeats
credentials.holder: each Fin service, sealed FIN_TELEMETRY_TOKEN, FIN_ERRORS_DSN and FIN_HEARTBEAT_<NAME>_URL
credentials.pending: P0-F's monitoring apply pull request adds rotate-betterstack.md

credentials.name: caller-keys
credentials.holder: each caller (edge, console, admin, verify, api, payments), sealed FIN_CALLER_KEY_1
credentials.issuer: pnpm fin secrets generate staging caller-keys
credentials.pending: the secrets command and rotate-caller-keys.md come with P0-D's caller signatures

credentials.name: database-logins
credentials.holder: each service with a login, sealed FIN_DB_PASSWORD (the _a login)
credentials.cadence: 180 days by switching to the idle _b login
credentials.pending: the db bootstrap command and rotate-db-login.md come with P0-E's bootstrap

credentials.name: watcher-read-tokens
credentials.issuer: cloudflare (minted by pnpm fin with CR-05)

credentials.name: vault-tokens
credentials.holder: the operator (ops, escrow, state buckets); worker (audit); backup (backups)
credentials.issuer: cloudflare R2 (pnpm fin vault create staging)
credentials.cadence: 180 days, staggered; the bucket-administration token 24 hours
credentials.pending: not issued: the vault waits for the escrow recipient (BD-14)
